author: BigGamer1337
quote:
Grand theft auto VI is a major departure from what made the series so iconic. When playing this game, a few thoughts swirl in the back of my mind, 'where is the fun?', 'where is the engagement?' and 'why have we regressed so far?'.

To inform you of how big of a change this game has been with the protagonists, let me simply explain.
GTA 5 allowed three different protagonists with interwoven story lines but with each character having their own motivations, backgrounds and personalities.
GTA 4 broke new ground with a more darkened story of a Serbian immigrant, attempting to escape his past but finding the land he has arrived at is no better to home and unable to escape his past.

GTA 6? The protagonists are watered down, sanitsied and dynamics forced upon the consumer. The game feels centred around 'relationships, love and belonging together'. The additional characters in the game are unfunny and bland.

IF you are buying strictly for the story, just don't.
IF you are buying for gameplay, just don't.

The gameplay is stuttering at 30fps and often drops below into what feels like single digits. There is this massive input lag that happens when controlling your character.
The challenge is simply missing in this game, I have really only died due to my own ignorance or lack of care and never because the game tested me.

Avoid this game.
